title: Hash map
summary: One million inserts/updates and one million lookups in a hash map.
description: Keys come from the MINSTD pseudo-random generator (x = x*48271 mod 2^31-1). Phase 1 counts occurrences of 1,000,000 keys drawn from 500,000 values; phase 2 looks up 1,000,000 further keys. Prints the number of distinct keys, a checksum and the number of hits.
reveals: Insertion, lookup and hashing speed of the standard hash map.
caveat: Key distribution and hash implementation dominate. Standard-library maps are used as they ship: Rust's default SipHash is deliberately DoS-resistant and slower; C has no standard map so a simple open-addressing table is hand-written.
